[Thinking]
**Finding antonyms for "stand out"**

I want to find an antonym for "stand out from," which means to be conspicuous or noticeable. The opposite idea would be to "blend in with." This phrase suggests something less distinct or noticeable. So, I'd say "blend in" fits well. Now, I'll provide a brief reasoning for why this works. Blending in implies being part of a group rather than being separate or distinct, which captures the essence of the antonym nicely!
[/Thinking]

A) Blend in with
